# Zhang Fei Threading Needles - Thick with Fine

Zhang Fei Threading Needles - Thick with Fine
Input file: standard input
Output file: standard output
Time limit: 1 second
Memory limit: 512 megabytes
The meaning of "Zhang Fei threading needles - thick with fine": People like Zhang Fei who appear careless
also have a meticulous side. Tell us not to look at the surface when looking at people, as each person’s
body contains abilities that others do not know.
When it comes to Zhang Fei, the words "rude and reckless"come to mind. Especially his roar on the
Changban Bridge in Dangyang scared away Cao Cao’s million strong army. General Xia Houjie was
startled to the point where his liver and gallbladder were shattered and he crashed into the horse. Even
the river under the bridge flows backwards, which can be said to be shocking and deeply remembered,
and has shaken the hearts of countless generations for thousands of years.
In his military career, whether it was capturing Liu Dai and Shi Yanyan, or in battles such as the powerful
Changban Bridge and the Eight Mongs winning Zhang He, he repeatedly made remarkable achievements
and became famous among the three armies, making ordinary people stand out. Therefore, there is a folk
saying of "Zhang Fei threading needles - thick with fine".
Do you know how many people on the Changban Bridge were scared away by Zhang Fei’s angry roar back
then?
Explanation: General Xia Houjie was shocked to the point where his liver and gallbladder were shattered
and he crashed into the horse, so he stayed in the local area and was not included in the number of people
who were scared away.
Input
The input is an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 1000000) , representing the number of Cao Cao’s troops in front of
the Changban Bridge.
Output
The output is an integer, which is the number of Cao Cao’s troops that Zhang Fei scared away with a
roar.

standard input standard output
500000 499999

# Zhang Fei Threading Needles - Thick with Fine

Time limit: $1$ second. Memory limit: $512$ MB. Standard input and standard output.

The saying “Zhang Fei threading needles — thick with fine” means that a person who appears careless can also be meticulous. We should not judge people only by appearances: they may have abilities that others do not know.

Zhang Fei is often described as rude and reckless. His roar at the Changban Bridge in Dangyang frightened away Cao Cao's million-strong army. General Xia Houjie was so frightened that his liver and gallbladder shattered and he fell from his horse. Even the river beneath the bridge flowed backwards. The scene was astonishing and has been remembered for generations.

![diagram](zhang-fei-portrait.png)

In his military career, whether capturing Liu Dai and Shi Yanyan, or fighting at the Changban Bridge and defeating Zhang He at Eight Mongs, he repeatedly achieved remarkable victories and became famous throughout the armies. Thus people say “Zhang Fei threading needles — thick with fine”.

How many of Cao Cao's troops were frightened away by Zhang Fei's roar at the Changban Bridge?

Explanation: Xia Houjie fell from his horse after being frightened to death, so he remained at the scene and is not counted among those frightened away.

## Input

The input is one integer $N$ ($1\leq N\leq1000000$), the number of Cao Cao's troops in front of the Changban Bridge.

## Output

Output one integer: the number of troops frightened away by Zhang Fei's roar.

# 张飞穿针——粗中有细

时间限制：$1$ 秒。内存限制：$512$ MB。使用标准输入和标准输出。

“张飞穿针——粗中有细”是说，像张飞这样表面粗犷、看似不拘小节的人，也有细致缜密的一面。这告诉我们看人不能只看表面，每个人都可能有旁人尚不了解的本领。

说到张飞，人们往往想到“粗鲁莽撞”。他在当阳长坂桥上一声怒吼，吓退了曹操的百万大军；夏侯杰更是被吓得肝胆俱裂、倒撞下马，连桥下的河水仿佛都为之倒流。那一幕惊心动魄，历经千年仍令人难忘。

![diagram](zhang-fei-portrait.png)

在张飞的戎马生涯中，从擒刘岱、释严颜，到威震长坂桥、八濛山战张郃，他屡立奇功，名扬三军，让人刮目相看。因此民间有了“张飞穿针——粗中有细”的说法。

那么，你知道当年张飞在长坂桥上一声怒吼，究竟吓跑了多少曹军吗？

说明：夏侯杰被吓得肝胆俱裂、倒撞下马，留在了原地，因此不计入被吓跑的人数。

## 输入

输入一个整数 $N$（$1\leq N\leq1000000$），表示长坂桥前曹军的人数。

## 输出

输出一个整数，表示被张飞一声怒吼吓跑的曹军人数。
